_comment: LDTD raid rules. A raid's budget = base + perNight x (raids survived) + perLevel x (Hearth level - 1), capped at max, and +callEarlyBonus when called at the Hearth. toughness: late raids send tougher Gloam, each unit's health x (1 + perNight x raids survived), up to max. Units are bought by weight from those allowed tonight (fromNight) until the budget runs out, each capped at maxShare of the budget. drain = Flame lost per second for each unit standing at the Hearth. Edit, then run /ldtd reload. payout: Duskglass paid into the stockpile for a raid survived (base + perRaid x raid number, x calledMultiplier if called early; nothing if the Hearth falls). The eclipse is never bought by the budget (weight 0); it joins raids once enough nearby Dusk Spires have fallen.
